notes: All 290 Java loot-table files are represented by Bedrock-format loot-table files.
Java apply_skill_data on magic tomes is replaced with weighted alternatives of individual Bedrock skill-book items.
Java apply_skill_data on Battlewill Manuals is replaced with tag-specific manual items that teach from the original Java tag pool.
Unsupported Java-only loot functions and conditions are listed for explicit compatibility replacements; see unsupportedFunctions and unsupportedConditions.
Matching loot tables are connected to matching Bedrock block/entity definitions where those definitions exist.
